scene: You trail the copper robot toward a secret misty orchid grove.
picture: Flat side-view along a stone path. On the far left, the round copper misting robot puffs vapor. Left of centre, the grandfather pushes his bicycle with crate of plants. Up high hangs a giant glowing blue orchid. On the far right stands a mossy stone archway opening into darkness.
shown: the round copper misting robot puffing steam, rolling on the far left
a giant glowing blue orchid dangling down, hanging up high
a mossy stone archway leading out into drizzle, on the far right

variants.scene: The steaming copper sphere leads your bicycle beneath a huge, glowing blue orchid.
You push your bicycle through warm mist as you search for {quest}.
Cool rain falls outside while bright blue petals illuminate the cozy glass conservatory.
